purpose: Create the implementation record, verify the citizen, connect operating applications and assign the first milestone.

steps.name: Create implementation record
steps.explanation: Create the shared start-up implementation identity and link the activated pack.
steps.requiredEvidence: Activated pack and citizen actor record

steps.name: Verify citizen and business profile
steps.explanation: Confirm identity, contact details, registration and eligibility.

steps.name: Connect operating applications
steps.explanation: Connect citizen, accounting, warehouse, logistics and traceability workspaces.

steps.name: Confirm first milestone
steps.explanation: Agree the baseline plan and first action with the citizen and coordinator.

rules.explanation: Every activation must have a shared identity and citizen actor.

purpose: Move the start-up from funding request through lawful approval, disbursement and utilisation evidence.

steps.name: Validate funding application
steps.explanation: Check eligibility, required documents, budget and policy conditions.

steps.name: Approve funding decision
steps.explanation: Approve, reject or request clarification using the authorised funding process.

steps.name: Release first tranche
steps.explanation: Verify bank details and release the approved tranche.

steps.name: Confirm utilisation
steps.explanation: Match spending evidence to the approved start-up plan before releasing the next tranche.

rules.explanation: Funding cannot be disbursed before the approved agreement and conditions are complete.

purpose: Recover production, quality or capacity before an offtaker commitment is missed.
institution: Extension, technical support and offtaker network

steps.name: Validate shortfall
steps.explanation: Compare the production plan, actual output, safe capacity and contract commitment.

steps.name: Assign technical support
steps.explanation: Assign extension, mining, manufacturing or specialist support based on the root cause.

steps.name: Agree recovery plan
steps.explanation: Create a recovery plan, substitute capacity or revised delivery plan with the buyer.

steps.name: Verify recovery
steps.explanation: Confirm output, quality and delivery performance after the intervention.

rules.explanation: A contract must be re-planned when committed supply exceeds safe capacity.

purpose: Resolve invoice and payment blockers before the start-up runs out of working capital.

steps.name: Validate invoice and delivery evidence
steps.explanation: Match invoice, purchase order, accepted delivery and supplier identity.
steps.requiredEvidence: Invoice, purchase order and proof of delivery

steps.name: Resolve exception
steps.explanation: Assign tax, price, quantity, bank or quality exceptions to the correct owner.

steps.name: Approve and reconcile payment
steps.explanation: Approve payment, confirm settlement and reconcile the supplier account.
steps.requiredEvidence: Approval, bank settlement and ledger reconciliation

rules.explanation: Overdue payments require an accountable escalation and cash-flow assessment.

workflowName: Weekly Ecosystem Health and Blocker Review
purpose: Review active start-ups, stale events, overdue tasks and emerging blockers before they become critical.

steps.name: Refresh implementation projections
steps.explanation: Rebuild health, milestone, funding, contract and event projections.

steps.name: Identify at-risk start-ups
steps.explanation: Find health-score changes, stale data, missed milestones and unresolved blockers.

steps.name: Dispatch interventions
steps.explanation: Run the relevant funding, extension, production, logistics or payment workflow.

steps.name: Escalate systemic constraints
steps.explanation: Group repeated blockers and escalate dependencies affecting multiple start-ups.

rules.explanation: Low health or repeated overdue milestones require an intervention.

purpose: Match citizens, farmers and small businesses with the right training, extension and technical support before capability gaps delay launch or production.
institution: SmallScaleExtensionWebApp, training providers and sector support organisations

steps.name: Assess capability gap
steps.explanation: Compare required skills for the selected start-up pack with the actor's declared skills, assessment results and operating context.
steps.requiredEvidence: Skills profile, assessment result and start-up requirements

steps.name: Assign training pathway
steps.explanation: Select classroom, field, digital or apprenticeship training and reserve a suitable provider or cohort.
steps.requiredEvidence: Training referral, provider acceptance and schedule

steps.name: Deliver extension intervention
steps.explanation: Provide practical coaching on production, quality, safety, record keeping or compliance at the operating site.
steps.requiredEvidence: Attendance, field-visit report and coaching plan

steps.name: Verify readiness
steps.explanation: Confirm the actor can safely perform the required activities and close or re-plan any remaining capability gap.

rules.explanation: A start-up cannot launch a safety-critical activity until the required competency is verified.

rules.machineExpression: training.required == true -> training.venueId != null && training.startDate != null
rules.explanation: Every training requirement must have a confirmed delivery location and date.

purpose: Ensure the inputs, tools, machinery, energy and maintenance support required by an economic actor are ready before the committed production date.
institution: Warehouse, extension, equipment suppliers and sector support services

steps.name: Translate plan into requirements
steps.explanation: Convert the production plan into quantities, specifications, delivery dates, equipment and service requirements.
steps.requiredEvidence: Approved production plan and bill of inputs

steps.name: Confirm availability and funding
steps.explanation: Check inventory, supplier capacity, approved budget, equipment-pool access and any import or procurement dependencies.
steps.requiredEvidence: Supplier quote, stock reservation and funding confirmation

steps.name: Deliver and commission
steps.explanation: Coordinate delivery, installation, calibration and safe-use orientation at the actor's operating site.
steps.requiredEvidence: Delivery note, commissioning checklist and handover

steps.name: Release production readiness
steps.explanation: Confirm all critical inputs and equipment are available and authorise the production milestone.

rules.explanation: Production cannot be released when critical inputs are not fully covered.
Equipment requiring commissioning must be approved before use.

escalations.action: Coordinate pooled capacity or priority procurement

purpose: Protect product quality, inventory accuracy and buyer commitments from receipt through storage and release.

steps.name: Receive and inspect stock
steps.explanation: Record quantity, quality, batch, origin and condition at the warehouse gate.
steps.requiredEvidence: Goods received note, inspection and batch record

steps.name: Put away and trace inventory
steps.explanation: Assign storage location, custody record and traceability identity for each lot or unit.

steps.name: Resolve quality or variance exception
steps.explanation: Investigate damaged, contaminated, missing or misclassified stock and determine disposition.
steps.requiredEvidence: Exception report, photos and disposition decision

steps.name: Release stock for dispatch
steps.explanation: Reserve compliant stock against the buyer order and issue the dispatch-ready confirmation.
steps.requiredEvidence: Stock reservation, release approval and pick list

rules.explanation: Stock cannot be released without origin and batch traceability.
A storage condition breach automatically quarantines affected stock for review.

escalations.action: Protect buyer allocation and arrange substitute stock

trigger: DispatchCreated or PickupMissed or InTransitDelay or ProofOfDeliveryMissing
purpose: Keep deliveries moving, make delays visible and recover buyer service levels when logistics events threaten an offtake commitment.

steps.name: Validate dispatch plan
steps.explanation: Match the order, released stock, vehicle capacity, route, driver and delivery window.
steps.requiredEvidence: Dispatch order, pick list and route plan

steps.name: Assign carrier and track movement
steps.explanation: Assign an approved carrier and monitor pickup, transit milestones and temperature or condition data where required.

steps.name: Recover delivery exception
steps.explanation: Reroute, replace the vehicle, notify the buyer or arrange substitute stock when a delivery milestone is missed.
steps.requiredEvidence: Exception decision, buyer notification and revised ETA

steps.name: Confirm delivery and billing release
steps.explanation: Capture proof of delivery, buyer acceptance and the evidence needed to release invoicing.
steps.requiredEvidence: Signed proof of delivery and buyer acceptance

rules.machineExpression: shipment.eta > order.deliveryWindow.end -> buyerNotification.required = true && recoveryPlan.required = true
rules.explanation: A late estimated arrival requires buyer communication and an active recovery plan.
An invoice cannot be released without delivery and buyer acceptance evidence.

escalations.action: Negotiate buyer recovery and protect contract score

trigger: OfftakerContractCreated or ContractVolumeRiskDetected or QualityFailureDetected or MarketPriceChanged
purpose: Keep offtake contracts commercially viable by monitoring volume, quality, price, delivery and buyer obligations across the ecosystem.
institution: Economic Intelligence Control Tower, producer network and offtaker

steps.name: Assess contract health
steps.explanation: Compare committed volume, quality, price, delivery dates, payment terms and current performance signals.
steps.requiredEvidence: Signed contract, forecast and performance data

steps.name: Coordinate corrective action
steps.explanation: Launch the relevant production, training, warehouse, logistics or payment workflow for the identified risk.
steps.requiredEvidence: Assigned corrective workflow and accountable owner

steps.name: Agree commercial adjustment
steps.explanation: Where necessary, agree revised quantity, delivery window, quality specification, price or substitute supply with the buyer.
steps.requiredEvidence: Approved variation, waiver or recovery agreement

steps.name: Verify contract recovery
steps.explanation: Confirm the next delivery, payment and quality milestones are back on track and update the contract score.
steps.requiredEvidence: Accepted delivery, settlement and contract health update

rules.explanation: A forecast below 90 percent of the contracted volume creates an intervention case.

rules.machineExpression: quality.rejectionRate > contract.maxRejectionRate -> correctiveAction.required = true && buyerNotification.required = true
rules.explanation: Quality performance above the contractual threshold must trigger corrective action and buyer communication.

escalations.action: Convene producer and buyer recovery review
Approve substitute supply, contract variation or executive intervention

trigger: SimulationSaved or StartUpPackDiscovered or eligibility evidence changed
purpose: Determine whether a citizen or organisation is ready to apply for a start-up pack and route missing requirements to the correct support actor.
institution: Economic Intelligence Control Tower, registry and programme administrators

steps.name: Match opportunity to actor profile
steps.explanation: Compare the selected industry, region, skills, funding preference and current production with the start-up pack requirements.
steps.requiredEvidence: Actor profile, target industry and selected opportunity

steps.name: Check eligibility conditions
steps.explanation: Evaluate age, location, ownership, registration, sector, policy and legal requirements using the available evidence.
steps.requiredEvidence: Identity, registration, location and policy evidence

steps.name: Create requirement resolution tasks
steps.explanation: Create stakeholder tasks for every missing or conflicting requirement instead of rejecting an otherwise viable opportunity.

steps.name: Issue qualification decision
steps.explanation: Mark the actor qualified, conditionally qualified or not yet qualified and provide the next action.

rules.explanation: Missing mandatory evidence creates a supported conditional qualification rather than an unexplained rejection.
An opportunity outside its target region must be referred to the appropriate programme or region.

escalations.action: Resolve missing evidence with the actor

trigger: Stage changes to Launch or LaunchReadinessRequested
purpose: Coordinate the final checks required before a farming, manufacturing, trading, mining, services or tourism start-up begins operating.
institution: Programme coordinator, registry, accounting, safety, logistics and extension stakeholders

steps.name: Confirm registration and operating location
steps.explanation: Verify the actor, operating address, permits, lease or land access and required sector registrations.

steps.name: Confirm people and safety readiness
steps.explanation: Check training completion, protective equipment, safety procedures and responsible supervisors.
steps.requiredEvidence: Competency, safety induction and equipment records

steps.name: Confirm applications and records
steps.explanation: Verify accounting, inventory, warehouse, logistics and traceability applications are connected where applicable.

steps.name: Approve go-live
steps.explanation: Release the start-up to operate, publish the first milestone and notify all accountable ecosystem participants.
steps.requiredEvidence: Signed go-live checklist and operating plan

rules.explanation: Safety-critical activities cannot move to Launch without verified readiness.
A start-up must have a connected operating record and approved plan before go-live.

trigger: quality score below threshold or inspection failed
purpose: Contain poor-quality, unsafe or untraceable output and help the actor correct the root cause before further sales or delivery.
institution: Quality authority, extension, producer, warehouse and offtaker

steps.name: Contain affected output
steps.explanation: Quarantine affected lots, stop unsafe dispatches and notify the relevant warehouse and buyer owners.
steps.requiredEvidence: Quarantine record, affected lot list and notifications

steps.name: Investigate root cause
steps.explanation: Trace inputs, process records, storage conditions, equipment, training and handling to identify the failure cause.

steps.name: Execute corrective action
steps.explanation: Implement the approved correction, which may include retraining, process change, equipment repair, rework or disposal.
steps.requiredEvidence: Corrective action plan and implementation evidence

steps.name: Release compliant output
steps.explanation: Repeat inspection and release only compliant output, updating the contract and quality score.

rules.explanation: Failed inspection or incomplete traceability automatically prevents dispatch.
Repeated failures require sector-level review and a strengthened support plan.

escalations.action: Approve enhanced corrective action or suspend release

workflowName: Cash-Flow Distress and Working Capital Recovery
trigger: cash runway below threshold or overdue receivable detected
purpose: Detect working-capital distress early and coordinate payment recovery, funding, cost controls and buyer actions before the actor stops operating.
institution: AccountingWebApp, funders, buyers and programme finance support

steps.name: Calculate cash runway
steps.explanation: Combine bank position, expected receipts, approved funding, committed costs and production obligations.

steps.name: Prioritise critical obligations
steps.explanation: Protect wages, safety, production inputs, taxes, utilities and contract-critical obligations while identifying deferrable spend.

steps.name: Recover receipts and funding
steps.explanation: Coordinate overdue invoice collection, funding release, buyer confirmation and approved short-term working capital.
steps.requiredEvidence: Collection plan, funding request or payment commitment

steps.name: Confirm stabilisation
steps.explanation: Verify runway improvement, settled critical obligations and an agreed monitoring cadence.
steps.requiredEvidence: Updated forecast, settlement evidence and recovery decision

rules.explanation: Less than 30 days of runway creates an early intervention case.
Severe cash distress locks critical obligations and requires finance leadership review.

escalations.action: Approve restructuring, bridge support or buyer intervention

trigger: ScaleRequestSubmitted or target milestone reached; monthly review
schedule: First business day of every month at 09:00 Africa/Johannesburg
purpose: Help proven start-ups scale responsibly into new regions, products, facilities or buyer channels without creating quality, funding or supply-chain bottlenecks.
institution: Economic Intelligence Control Tower, funders, offtakers and sector institutions

steps.name: Review proven performance
steps.explanation: Assess production, quality, cash flow, contracts, employment, compliance and operating health over the review period.
steps.requiredEvidence: Verified performance dashboard and trend analysis

steps.name: Test scale scenario
steps.explanation: Model the effect of increased volume, new locations, additional staff, equipment, funding and buyer commitments.

steps.name: Approve scale safeguards
steps.explanation: Agree capital, skills, quality, working capital, logistics, environmental and governance safeguards before expansion.
steps.requiredEvidence: Scale plan, risk register and safeguard approvals

steps.name: Launch replication and monitor
steps.explanation: Create the expansion implementation, assign support workflows and monitor the first scale milestones.

rules.explanation: Scale eligibility requires healthy operations, quality performance and sufficient runway.
High dependence on one buyer or region requires a diversification plan before scaling.

escalations.action: Decide scale funding or defer expansion
